description: Seven-row bounded GICOV ellipse score using the source-ordered binary32 sum and Welford variance recurrence.

pinned_source.license: University of Virginia BSD-3-Clause; full terms and citation list in LICENSE.txt.

layout: 7 consecutive rows of point_count projected gradient samples
input.decoding: Each sample becomes f32(f32(raw) / f32(1000000)); samples are the source directional-gradient projection grad_x*cos_angle + grad_y*sin_angle.

output.meaning: Maximum source-order binary32 GICOV score across the seven ellipse rows, promoted to binary64.
output.formula: max(0, f32(f32(mean*mean)/sample_variance)) over rows; mean=sum/N and sample_variance=M2/(N-1), with sum and Welford M2 accumulated in source order.
output.zero_variance: Outside the finite profile domain; return invalid sentinel.

arithmetic.precision: Binary32 at each source float accumulation/update and score operation; returned score is promoted to binary64.
arithmetic.ordering: Seven ellipses ascending; within each row, points ascending; add to sum, then Welford delta, mean update, and M2 update. Replace mean with sum/N before variance and score.
